english.title: Take / cause vehicle to be taken into Blackwall / Silvertown Tunnels likely to break down / injure / damage property
english.standardoffencewording:

into the

(C)_[Blackwall]_

english.legislation: Contrary to byelaw 7(9) of the Blackwall and Silvertown Tunnels Byelaws 2018 and article 48(6) of the Silvertown Tunnel Order 2018
